post.caption:
3 quotes for when you feel behind in life 🌅

I. "Begin at once to live, and count each separate day as a separate life." — Seneca
II. "The two most powerful warriors are patience and time." — Leo Tolstoy
III. You are not behind. You are simply beginning again, wiser.

Which one do you need today? I, II or III 👇
Send this to someone who feels behind. 🤍

youtube.description:
3 quotes to slow down with when you feel behind in life.

I. "Begin at once to live, and count each separate day as a separate life." — Seneca
You don't need to catch up on years. Just live today well.

II. "The two most powerful warriors are patience and time." — Leo Tolstoy, War and Peace
The things that matter grow slowly. Let them.

III. You are not behind. You are simply beginning again, wiser.
Every restart carries everything you've learned.

Which one do you need today? Comment I, II or III.

Send this to someone who feels behind, and subscribe for one idea and one reflection to carry through your day. 🌿
